metadata.title: Parabolic defect measures for Harmonic Maps with Free Boundary
metadata.abstract: We introduce defect measures for the heat flow of a class of harmonic maps with free boundary and initiate their analysis. Our flow is motivated by singular perturbations on the boundary of the domain, emphasizing structural differences between harmonic maps with free boundary and their classical counterpart. The harmonic maps we consider are a reformulation of maps introduced by Da Lio and Rivière and arise in several problems in the spectral geometry of Steklov eigenvalues. Contrary to the classical case, the flow we consider exhibits features of global nature and the blow-up analysis turns out to be much more challenging.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究自由边界调和映射流的抛物型缺陷测度，并引入与边界奇异摄动及 Steklov 谱相关的分析框架。
analysis.breakthrough: 把流的能量集中问题与非局部边界结构联系起来，指出通常吹起分析面临的全局困难。
analysis.limitations: 摘要描述的是分析框架与初步性质，不能读作完整奇点分类或全部正则性定理。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 自由边界、能量集中和吹起技术对几何分析有较高复用价值。
